描述_EN: cizhou was a popular ware, meaning that it was made not for the imperial household or elite connoisseurs, but ordinary people. guantai was an important kiln in the manufacture of cizhou ware, a type of ceramic made in the northern part of china during the jin dynasty (1115-1234). figurines similar to the ceramic monkey pictured were a popular product of the kiln site called guantai in china between the years 950-1150. figurines such as this might have been used for play, but have also been found in tombs. this meant that cizhou kilns produced wares in a great variety of shapes, forms and decorations, such as this monkey.
描述_ZN: 慈禧是一种流行的器物，这意味着它不是为皇室或精英鉴赏家制作的，而是为普通人制作的。 官台是中国北方地区在金代（1115-1234年）制造陶瓷的重要窑场，也是慈禧的一个重要窑场。 类似于图中的陶瓷猴子的雕像是950-1150年间中国关帝窑的流行产品。 像这样的小动物可能是用来玩的，但也在墓葬中被发现。 这意味着慈溪窑生产的器物有很多不同的形状、形式和装饰，比如这个猴子。
